UnitedHealthcare® UHC Choice Plus HSA Gold 1700-4

Carrier: UnitedHealthcare. Plan type: POS. Period: 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.

26 benefits are placed in CARIN SBC benefit categories. 3 benefits have no code in the SBC benefit category code system and are listed, by identity only, in the bps-unmapped-benefit extension.

Converted from Benefit Plan Standard document UHC_CHOICE_PLUS_HSA_GOLD_1700 (schema version 1.1.0).

extension.valueString: UHC Choice Plus HSA Gold 1700-4 | Coverage Period: 01/01/2026 - 12/31/2026 | Coverage for: Employee/Family | Plan Type: POS
What is the overall deductible? Designated Network and Network: $1,700 Individual / $3,400 Family; out-of-Network: $5,000 Individual / $10,000 Family Per Calendar year.

What is the out-of-pocket limit for this plan? Designated Network and Network: $4,500 Individual / $9,000 Family; out-of-Network: $10,000 Individual / $20,000 Family. (This file carries the $9,000 family limit and not the $4,500 individual limit.)
Primary care visit to treat an injury or illness: $10 copay per visit (Designated Network and Network); 40% coinsurance out-of-Network
Specialist visit: Designated Network $30 copay per visit / Network Provider $60 copay per visit; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network. (This file carries the Designated Network value.)
Preventive care/screening/immunization: No Charge; Out-of-Network: Not Covered

Diagnostic test: Designated Network Lab: 0% coinsurance / Free Standing/Office X-ray: $30 copay per service; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network. (The document prints the lab and x-ray prices separately; this file carries both in one in-network entry, as a $30 copay step and a 0% coinsurance step.)

Imaging (CT/PET scans, MRIs): Designated Network $150 copay per service / Free Standing/Office $500 copay per service; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network. (This file carries the Designated Network value.)

Tier 1 - Your Lowest-Cost Option: Retail: $10 copay. Tier 2 - Your Midrange-Cost Option: Retail: $40 copay. Tier 3 - Your Midrange-Cost Option: Retail: $75 copay. Tier 4 - Additional High-Cost Options: Retail: $125 copay. (The document also prints mail-order and specialty-pharmacy prices; this file carries only the retail values.)
Outpatient surgery - Facility fee: Ambulatory Surgery Center: $200 copay per visit / Hospital: $400 copay per visit; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network. Physician/surgeon fees: 20% coinsurance
Emergency room care: $400 copay per visit (all tiers). Emergency medical transportation: 20% coinsurance.
Urgent care: $40 copay per visit; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network
Hospital stay - Facility fee: $350 copay per admission; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network. Physician/surgeon fees: 20% coinsurance
Mental health outpatient services: $30 copay per visit; out-of-Network: 0% coinsurance. Inpatient services: $350 copay per admission; 40% coinsurance out-of-Network
Childbirth/delivery professional services: 20% coinsurance. Childbirth/delivery facility services: $350 copay per admission
Home health care: 20% coinsurance. Limited to 90 visits up to 4 hours per visit per episode of care.
Rehabilitation services: $10 copay per outpatient visit. Habilitation services: $10 copay per outpatient visit.
Skilled nursing care: $350 copay per admission. Skilled Nursing Facility is limited to 60 days per calendar year.
Durable medical equipment: 20% coinsurance; Out-of-Network: Not Covered. Hospice services: 20% coinsurance.
Children's eye exam: $10 copay per visit, deductible does not apply; Out-of-Network: 50% coinsurance. Children's glasses: 50% coinsurance. Children's dental check-up: No Charge.
Services Your Plan Generally Does NOT Cover: Bariatric surgery, Long-term care, Cosmetic surgery, Dental care (Adult)
Other Covered Services: Chiropractic care, Acupuncture - Anesthesia only, Infertility treatment, Hearing aids - $2,500/Calendar year
